basis: Manual visual inspection of all four 1536x1024 raw boards, enlarged boundary-crossing cells, the despilled recomposed contact sheet, technical overlays and root-registered playbacks.

sameNaturalCompactWildBoar.note: All poses remain recognizably the same compact adult wild boar: low shoulder mass, long snout, two tusks, four mammalian legs and a short tail.

identity.earthyBristles: dark russet-brown organic coat retained across 32/32 poses
identity.tusks: paired pale tusks remain readable without becoming oversized fantasy weapons
identity.hooves: four cloven-hoof legs remain mammalian and grounded
identity.tail: short natural boar tail retained; no blade or xenomorph tail
identity.restrainedInjury: death may show restrained blood; no dismemberment or mutation
identity.anatomy: natural quadruped boar anatomy only; no biomechanical carapace, dorsal tubes, inner jaw, armor, humanoid torso or fantasy-monster appendage

direction.deathQualification: Collapsed terminal poses preserve the right-facing snout/tusk axis while the body settles laterally; no camera-facing belly-up roll is used.

motion.idle: Eight distinct grounded breathing, ear and weight-shift poses; loop closure is visually plausible.
motion.move: Eight distinct natural quadruped walk/run phases with alternating hooves.

attack.tuskHeadDriveCore: frames 4-6 read as a low forward head/tusk shove

death.note: The authored one-shot ends prone; runtime hold behavior is outside this standalone processing pass.

observedDrift: individual bristle clumps and highlights vary between generated poses
minor tusk curvature and ear-fold details are not pixel-identical across clips
restrained injury marks vary during the authored death progression

algorithm.topology: foreground-only pixels within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background

residualMatteHueThreshold.purpose: remove only edge pixels retaining matte-like R/B parity; russet/brown with low blue is excluded

deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels in one nominal target cell
deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.basis: independent neutral-background audit of violet-magenta crest, belly, tail and leg contamination

algorithm.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the strict magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
algorithm.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
algorithm.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero

technicalCorrection.scope: RGB changes only on declared foreground edge-spill pixels

defects.impact: Broad natural-boar identity is consistent, but individual bristle, ear and tusk micro-details are not pixel-identical.
The candidates remain unnormalized, unaccepted and outside runtime by design.
